glossary.positionSizeUSDC: The trade's collateral in USDC (1e6). Misleading name: NOT the leveraged position size.
glossary.initialPosToken: Always 0 on opens. On increases: the additional collateral being added (1e6).
glossary._amount: Collateral being closed, in USDC (1e6); request param collateralToCloseUsdc.
glossary._openTimestamp: The position's on-chain open timestamp; binds a close intent to the exact position instance (PositionMismatch on drift).
glossary.timestamp: In TpSlReq: same position-instance binding as _openTimestamp. In Trade: set by the contract, 0 in requests.
glossary.wantedPrice: Expected execution price (1e10) used for slippage checks; request param expectedPrice.
glossary.defaultLeverage: Target fill leverage (1e10); request param leverage.
glossary.coinSize: Exposure in base-asset units (1e10); request params coinExposure / coinExposureToClose.
glossary.buy: true = long, false = short; request param side.
glossary.orderType: In TpSlReq: PARTIAL_TP(4) / PARTIAL_SL(5); request param kind (take_profit | stop_loss).
glossary.percentage: TpSlReq percentage trigger: signed int256, 1e10 = 1% (negative allowed).
glossary.signTimestamp: TpSlReq freshness stamp in milliseconds; must not be in the future. TpSlReq has NO deadline field.
glossary._deadline: Intent expiry in unix MILLISECONDS (contract checks deadline/1000 >= block.timestamp).
glossary.expiry: DelegateReq delegation expiry in unix SECONDS.
glossary.tnc: Fixed Terms-of-Service constant; sign the returned string verbatim.
glossary._nonce: Signer-chosen 256-bit nonce on a Permit2-style unordered bitmap (no sequencing).
glossary.twapId: On-chain id of a TWAP order (from the twap-app open response or the twaps list); cancels are scoped to it.
glossary.entityId: Storage id of an off-chain partial TP/SL (named documentId before the /price-triggers migration); CancelOffchainOrder signs over it as proof of ownership (verified off-chain, never submitted on-chain).

selectedFunctions.label: Veranta avUSDC deposit
warnings: Veranta is the current brand of Avantis. This is the current unified Base avUSDC LP vault at the former junior proxy, not a separate senior/junior tranche or a legacy veTranche staking product. Explorer jUSDC labels are historical; applicable implementation name()/symbol() return Avantis USDC Vault/avUSDC.

LP principal is exposed to trader payouts, buffer depletion, trading/oracle and market-making risk, smart-contract upgrades, governance and USDC risk. Depositing LP liquidity does not make leveraged trading or the yield strategy safe; no principal, APY or redemption guarantee is provided.

Current SDK vault docs explicitly describe no lock and no epoch/request/claim cycle. withdraw/redeem are immediate only if liquidity and utilization permit: the implementation checks adjusted balances, reserved assets, withdrawThreshold and actual ERC20 liquidity. There is no admitted request/claim fallback when an exit reverts.

Deposit cap and fee configuration are mutable. previews include configured fees; withdrawal collateral-health fees can apply. maxWithdraw/maxRedeem are not a success guarantee because fees, balance and utilization can change, and the post-withdraw utilization threshold is strict.

USDC asset amounts and avUSDC shares use their onchain integer units; shares are not guaranteed 1:1 with USDC. Deposit/mint require caller USDC allowance to this exact vault; receiver receives shares. Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares and pay receiver; caller != owner requires share allowance.

No fresh RPC storage/runtime identity, current cap/fee/reserve/allowance/paused-state, liquidity, successful execution or wallet eligibility verification was performed. Catalog membership does not bypass authorization, canonical calldata, pause or final execution checks.
